scope: Metadata correction and provenance clarification only; fixed feature NPZs, source CSV caches, models, and predictions were not regenerated or modified.

t5_cache.population_geometry: The builder loops over _train_arrays() and _test_arrays(); shared unlabeled harbor candidates therefore include Jan-Jun 2026 Train and 2025 Test geometry.
t5_cache.mask_application: The global fishing mask is applied to active 2026 Train rows using the shared harbor candidates plus Train-only own moorings.
t5_cache.label_scope: Fold-specific class distributions use FIT labels only; held-out labels are not used for T5 construction.
t5_cache.query_scope: Each development vessel query uses its full observed Jan-Jun 2026 Train track.
t5_cache.caveat: The cached T5 CSVs have verified vessel IDs and schema. A bitwise comparison with the original in-memory dynamic T5 arrays was not performed; CSV float round-trip differences are therefore unmeasured.

feature_scope.X304: 156 F156 + 10 T5 + 68 B behavior features excluding obs_days + 70 local_rel features = 304 columns.
feature_scope.B68: Deterministic per-vessel aggregation from that vessel’s own full Jan-Jun 2026 observations; no cross-vessel population statistic.
feature_scope.local_rel70: Uses cohort-level 2026 Train medians/MADs by 0.1-degree region, with small-region fallback; self is included. This is transductive across FIT/INNER/OUTER roles.
feature_scope.coordinates: No timestamp-aligned coordinate speed or acceleration is claimed.
